name: toast
title: Toast
description: One note, what just happened: the card's #171717 fill, a hairline and the brand corner, a DM Sans Medium title, a muted line, one small White button when there is something to do, and a close button.
use_for: The surface of a note: Sonner stacks and times these in a corner. On its own, a note that stays where it is.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
More than one button in a note
A colored fill or an icon in a spectrum color for success
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no toast in the brand assets): the plan card's #171717 fill and corner, DM Sans Medium for the title, the White primary button
